content.text: Challenge Prompt: Slow and Steady. Build something with open-source AI at its core for International Sloth Day that rewards laziness.

Designing and building SnoozeScape: An offline wind-down bedtime companion that generates calming micro-stories and procedural ambient soundscapes using open-weight models (WebGPU Transformers.js + Web Audio API).
